_about: The words every batch must write the same way. For each language, i18n/tr/<lang>/_terms.json gives the chosen form for every entry here, plus the style choices at the end.

rites.Ihram: the state and the two cloths
rites.Raml: brisk walk in the first three circuits
rites.Istilam: touching or gesturing to the Black Stone

app.Miqah: the app's name: keep in Latin letters
app.circuit / round: one of the seven of tawaf
app.lap: one of the seven of sa'i
app.the “I'm lost” card: a card shown to a stranger
app.driver card: a card shown to a taxi driver
app.keepsake: a picture of the finished journey
app.Nusuk: the official Saudi app: keep in Latin letters

_style.address: How the reader is addressed (formal or informal 'you'), and why that suits a religious guide in this language.
_style.register: One or two sentences on tone and sentence style.
_style.punctuation: Comma, question mark, quotation marks and any spacing rules of this language.
_style.transliteration: How Arabic phrases given in Latin letters (e.g. 'Labbayk Allahumma labbayk') are shown: kept in Latin, or written in this language's script, and how.
_style.numerals: The app always supplies digits 0-9 through placeholders; say only if anything in the text itself needs care.
_style.notes: Anything else a translator of this language must know.
